## Acceptance Criteria
- full-copy.ts: copies all records for a table filtered by accountId
- recent-copy.ts: time-filtered copying using GSI and date range
- sampled-copy.ts: recent N records plus random sample of older records
- All strategies handle pagination, errors, and logging

## Implementation Steps
- Implement fullCopy() with productionClient.models[table].list() pagination loop
- Implement recentCopy() with date filtering on sortKey field
- Implement sampledCopy() with two queries (recent + older) and random sampling
- Add error handling for individual item failures (continue on error)
- Clean metadata fields (createdAt, updatedAt, owner) before sandbox write
